relocation_line: I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start three weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Chalouhi team,

I'm Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your advert says recent graduates are strongly encouraged to apply, so here I am.

On site in the Philippines, from April 2019 to February 2020, I checked drawings against the work, did site inspections and quality checks, coordinated crews and wrote the site and progress reports. I also use AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

I'd move to Sydney and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
